limitations: The safety relation is formalized as: when ETH is sent via msg.value during a swap, debt accounting must be performed. The stuck-ETH impact is recorded as a separate observable and is not asserted as certain by this rule.
The exact sqrtRatioLimit value is described only as tickToSqrtRatio(0-500) in the PoC, not as a general precondition, so it is represented qualitatively.
Whether the no-op path is reached by front-running or legitimate price movement is not fixed by this plan.
The near-price sqrtRatioLimit condition is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no general numeric definition.
The stuck-forever duration qualifier is represented as a grounded Boolean outcome symbol rather than a timed relation.
Whether the no-op path is reached by front-running or legitimate price movement is not fixed by this claim.

The safety relation is stated as a progress/obligation: when ETH is sent via msg.value during a swap, debt accounting must run; the stuck-ETH impact is captured as a separate qualitative extractability observable rather than derived from the obligation.
The exact sqrtRatioLimit value is described only as tickToSqrtRatio(0-500) in the PoC and is not encoded as a general precondition.
The stuck-ETH non-extractability is represented as a Boolean observable grounded in the impact statement; no recovery-mechanism enumeration is formalized.
The intent's 'without accounting or refund' is encoded as a single Boolean effect predicate rather than separate accounting and refund observables.
